desc: Pro-Shot's 1-Step Cleaner is environmentally friendly and features a non-Hazardous formula that leaves barrels totally clean and protected. It removes lead, powder, plastic, copper (jacketed) and primer fouling. The lubricant and protectant features rust inhibitors and special additives which soak into the metal and provide a corrosion barrier for superior rust protection. This model comes in an 8 oz bottle.
